units.source_text: 深夜，在特別看守室隔壁的值班室裡，一位值夜班的老警察悄悄開啟房門。

en.t: Late at night, in the duty room next to the special holding room, an old policeman on night watch quietly opened the door.

units.source_text: 「喂！」他衝我說道，「冷不冷？到這兒暖和暖和。」

en.t: "Hey!" he said to me. "Are you cold? Come over here and warm yourself."

units.source_text: 我假裝無精打采地走進值班室，坐在椅子上圍著火盆取暖。

en.t: I pretended to be listless as I went into the duty room, sat down on a chair, and warmed myself by the brazier.

units.source_text: 「你還在想那位死去的女人吧？」

en.t: "You are still thinking about the woman who died, aren't you?"

units.source_text: 「是的。」我故意用小得幾乎聽不清楚的聲音回答道。

en.t: "Yes," I answered deliberately in a voice so small it could hardly be heard.

units.source_text: 「這也是人之常情嘛。」他漸漸拉開架勢。

en.t: "That is only human nature," he said, gradually assuming a more expansive air.

units.source_text: 「你第一次跟女人發生關係，是在哪兒？」

en.t: "Where was it that you first had relations with a woman?"
